title: Convert ticks to seconds
prompt: Write seconds(ticks,rate=20). Example: 60 ticks gives 3.0 seconds.
tests:
assert seconds(60)==3, '60 ticks at 20 Hz is 3 seconds'
assert seconds(10,10)==1, 'Use the supplied rate'
assert seconds(0)==0, 'Tick zero is time zero'

title: Regenerate with a cap
prompt: Write regen(elixir,dt,multiplier=1), using dt*multiplier/2.8 and cap 10. Example: regen(5,2.8,2)=7.
tests:
assert abs(regen(5,2.8,2)-7)<1e-12, 'Double phase regenerates twice as much'
assert regen(9,2.8,3)==10, 'Elixir cannot exceed ten'
assert abs(regen(0,.05)-.05/2.8)<1e-12, 'Keep fractional tick gains'
hint: Apply the multiplier to gain, not current elixir.

title: Phase boundaries
prompt: Implement toy_phase(seconds): 1 below 120, 2 below 180, else 3. Example: exactly 120 returns 2.
solution:
def toy_phase(seconds):
    if seconds<120: return 1
    if seconds<180: return 2
    return 3
tests: assert [toy_phase(t) for t in [0,119.99,120,179.99,180]]==[1,1,2,2,3], 'Apply the declared toy boundaries exactly'

title: Move forward on the board
prompt: Write forward(y,speed,dt), decreasing y and clamping at 0. Example: forward(20,2,.5)=19.
tests:
assert forward(20,2,.5)==19, 'Forward decreases y'
assert forward(.2,2,1)==0, 'Clamp at the toy destination'
assert forward(20,2,0)==20, 'Zero time means zero movement'
hint: Distance is speed times elapsed time.

title: Check hand and affordability
prompt: Write legal(card,hand,elixir,costs), True only if card is in hand, has a supplied cost, and is affordable. Example: an affordable X-Bow outside hand is False.
solution:
def legal(card,hand,elixir,costs):
    return card in hand and card in costs and costs[card]<=elixir
tests:
c={'X-Bow':6,'Skeletons':1}
assert legal('X-Bow',['X-Bow'],6,c), 'Exact affordability is legal'
assert not legal('X-Bow',['Skeletons'],10,c), 'A card outside hand is illegal'
assert not legal('X-Bow',['X-Bow'],5,c), 'Insufficient elixir is illegal'
assert not legal('unknown',['unknown'],10,c), 'Unknown cost must not be guessed'
hint: Use short-circuit and before dictionary indexing.
